concepts.name: liver
concepts.definition: The liver is a large abdominal organ inferior to the diaphragm and predominantly in the right upper abdomen.

concepts.name: kidney
concepts.definition: The kidneys are paired retroperitoneal organs on either side of the spine, posterior to the abdominal viscera.

concepts.name: spleen
concepts.definition: The spleen lies in the left upper abdomen, lateral to the stomach and inferior to the diaphragm.

concepts.name: pancreas
concepts.definition: The pancreas is an elongated gland posterior to the stomach, extending toward the splenic hilum.
